title: Changing the Commitment on Operating Lines of Credit During a Term
content:
The commitment on one of the Operating Lines of Credit may be changed only while the line is in active status, as the association's record of that line shows.

## Increase

1. A mid-term increase is requested as a commitment increase request for the amount of the increase.
2. The increase may not exceed the product's largest mid-term increase percentage of the commitment in force, and it must keep the new commitment within the product's largest commitment and within the aggregate commitment limit.
3. It takes effect only on credit approval, and at most 1 increase may take effect in one term.
4. On the effective date a fee of the product's commitment increase fee percentage of the increase, rounded to cents, is assessed; no fee charge is booked where the percentage is zero.
5. A product whose largest mid-term increase percentage is zero takes no mid-term increase.

## Reduction

The member may reduce the commitment at any time, with immediate effect, to any amount that is no lower than the outstanding principal and no lower than the product's smallest commitment. A reduction carries no fee and refunds no fee already charged.

## Cases (hypothetical Revolving Operating Line, commitment in force USD 400,000, largest increase 25%, increase fee 0.25%)

| Request | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Increase of USD 100,000 | Equal to 25% of USD 400,000; within the percentage. On approval the commitment becomes USD 500,000 and a fee of USD 250.00 is assessed |
| Increase of USD 120,000 | Above 25% of the commitment in force; not within the allowance |
| A second increase in the same term after one has taken effect | Not available — at most 1 per term |
| Reduction to USD 150,000 with USD 180,000 outstanding | Below the outstanding principal; not available |
| Reduction to USD 200,000 with USD 180,000 outstanding | Available at once, no fee |
